{{Quote|<nowiki>T7 = identified bounty hunter employer // Payment = authorized by office of Republic Senator // Senator = Verre Sydia</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="The Senator's Secret" />}}
'''Verre Sydia''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] through the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A fierce opponent of the Empire, Sydia unknowingly [[Marriage/Legends|married]] an [[Verre Sydia's husband|Imperial spy]] who used her [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] resources behind her back. Her husband's actions led the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] to suspect Sydia of [[Treason/Legends|treason]], but the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] discovered the husband's allegiances and had the latter arrested, clearing Senator Sydia of wrongdoing.

==Biography==
{{Quote|<nowiki>SIS surveillance = cleared Senator Sydia's name // Imperial traitor = Sydia's husband // Husband = arrested this morning</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="The Truth Comes Out">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Truth Comes Out}}</ref>}}
A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Verre Sydia was a staunch and occasionally outspoken opponent of the Empire. Sydia [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Verre Sydia's husband|man]] at some point before her tenure as senator, but she was unaware of her husband's true allegiance as an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]],<ref name="Terrin Sandafar">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Terrin Sandafar}}</ref> and around [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} Ten and twenty years before 3643 BBY respectively correspond to [[3663 BBY]] and 3653 BBY.</ref> the man used her access to classified [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] accounts to hire the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]].<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" />

Sandafar [[Death/Legends|killed]] an Imperial spy named [[Eckhorn Baliss]] to stop a list of Imperial traitors in the Republic from getting out, and she was hired again by Sydia's husband<ref name="Eckhorn's List">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Eckhorn's List}}</ref> a [[3653 BBY|decade later]],<ref name="Time" /> when Sydia was still serving as senator.<ref name="Eckhorn's List" /> Sandafar was hired to kill the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Shafu]] when the former [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] was close to locating the list of traitors for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="Shafu's Report">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Shafu's Report}}</ref> and Sydia's husband killed Sandafar as well to cover up the crimes.<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" /> While the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] suspected Sydia of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]<ref name="The Senator's Secret" /> around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> they discovered Sydia's husband's allegiances and had the individual arrested, clearing the senator's name.<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|<nowiki>T7 = confused // Senator Sydia = strong opponent of Empire // Sydia = not logical traitor</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="The Senator's Secret" />}}
Verre Sydia was a staunch proponent of the Galactic Republic that she served and a fierce opponent of the Sith Empire,<ref name="The Senator's Secret" /> although she had no suspicion of her husband's true allegiances.<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" /> Her loyalty was such that T7-O1 believed it far-fetched to consider her betraying the Republic when her connection to Sandafar was discovered.<ref name="The Senator's Secret" />

==Behind the scenes==
Verre Sydia is mentioned in several optional conversations with the Jedi Knight companion character T7-O1 in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Senator's Secret" /> She also has an NPC entry in the game's files with the title "Senator Verre Sydia," where she is listed in the NPCs for T7-O1's companion quests along with a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], bounty hunter, and another character named "Gurn," all at level 16. However, none of these characters appeared in the final version of the game.<ref name="Model">{{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/senator-verre-sydia|text=Senator Verre Sydia|work=[[Jedipedia]]|archivedate=20210918172552}}</ref>
